name: Route53 Resolver Log Deletion
description: Route53 Resolver can log DNS queries to CloudWatch or S3. An attacker with route53resolver:DeleteResolverQueryLogConfig deletes the query log configuration, stopping DNS query logging. This evades DNS-based detection (e.g., for C2 communication or data exfiltration via DNS). Required permission is route53resolver:DeleteResolverQueryLogConfig. The attacker may also need to disassociate the config from VPCs.
